title: The Lathe of Heaven
author: Ursula K. Le Guin
summary: George Orr discovers that his dreams can change reality. His psychiatrist, Dr Haber, sees a chance to improve the world by guiding those dreams, with unexpected results.
readIf: you like short, thoughtful science fiction about power, control and the limits of improving the world.
skipIf: you want detailed world-building or a fast-paced adventure.
